state:
**Goal `ldap`, Stage 10 (the feature proofs) is under way.** Stages 1 to 5 and 7 to 9 are done; Stage 4 lacks only a CA a program supplies, and Stage 6 lacks only wiring the schema into the readers. `Core\Ldap`, `Core\Ldap\Filter`, `Core\Ldap\Dn`, `Core\Ldap\Sid`, `Core\Ldap\Ad` and `Core\Ldap\Change` owe nothing.

**16 of the 17 `Core\Ldap\Entry` members owe nothing**; only `isDeleted` still owes `about.md`, three examples, one attack and one bench. **`Core\Ldap\Ad\GroupType`'s `security`, `bits` and `with` owe nothing.** Its six other flag readers and all 24 `Core\Ldap\Ad\AccountFlags` members still owe `about.md`, three examples, one attack and one bench each; every one has its tests proof. `Core\Ldap\Connection` (`setPassword`, `changePassword`, `compare`), `Core\Ldap\Entries` (`references`, `total`) and `Core\Ldap\Changes::cookie` owe everything, and `total` and `cookie` also owe a Rust test with a `covers:` marker.

**The proof trees are granted `[ldap.corp]` by directory** in the root `nvs.toml`: `Ldap-Entry` and `Ldap-Ad-GroupType` under each of the three trees. Add the `Ldap-Ad-AccountFlags` blocks only in the same edit that creates those directories: an `[[app]] root` that names a missing directory fails every program in the repository with `E0605`. Run a draft from the repository root with `target/covws/<triple>/debug/nvs.exe run <file>`. `docs/examples/core/Ldap-Ad-GroupType/` is a model for a flag reader.

**The `samba-ad` domain is seeded** by `20-novis-seed` in `tests/db/compose.yaml` (its comment lists every user, group and password). `[ldap.corp]` binds as the read-only `CN=Reader,OU=Company,DC=example,DC=test`.

**Seeded facts a proof can print:** RIDs follow the seed order (`Reader` 1103, `Employees` 1104, `Managers` 1105, `Newsletter` 1106, `anna.berg` 1107, `ben.kohl` 1108, `dora.lind` 1110), `Administrator` is 500. `userAccountControl` is 512 for `anna.berg` and `carla.diaz`, 514 for `dora.lind` and 66048 for `ben.kohl` and `Reader`. `carla.diaz` has `pwdLastSet` 0. `groupType` is -2147483646 for `Employees` and `Managers` (global security) and 2 for `Newsletter` (global distribution); no seeded group is system, domain local, universal or an application group, so those readers are shown on a `with` copy. `OU=Company` has five users and three groups. The domain has `maxPwdAge` 6w, `minPwdLength` 7 and `pwdHistoryLength` 24. GUIDs, SIDs and timestamps differ per boot.

**`Reader` cannot read any attribute of a deleted object**, so `isDeleted()` is `false` on everything it can find, and the seed deletes nothing.
